name: Zevs LLC
note: Moscow limited-liability company (ООО «Зевс», registered 24 Apr 2019, register activity: letting and management of real estate). Owned 50/50 by two private individuals per EGRUL (Rusprofile, July 2025 snapshot): Andrey Nikolaevich Petukhov and Darina Borisovna Denisova. No state body or fund in the chain. Rusprofile also notes the two individuals were on Ukraine sanctions lists; sanctions records don't count towards a rating (METHOD.md).
